statements.proposition: This change keeps existing v1 text-format files (and existing behaviour) working: v1 parsing and writing are unchanged in outcome.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Settled by a concrete check: the pre-existing test suite, including v1 text round-trips, passes against the head puz.py. Two pre-existing parametrised round-trip tests fail only for the two NEW v2 testfiles because the old test code does not pass 'v2'; that is a test-harness consequence of new files, not a v1 break. Only additions to the public API; v2 parsing is gated on file_version == 'v2'. Pull request was closed unmerged; irrelevant to the proposition.
evidence: gh api pulls/49/files: puz.py modified (+208/-3), tests.py modified, demo_v2.py and 2 testfiles added; no files removed or renamed
